entities.summary: Saroo Brierley is an Indian-born Australian businessman and author who, at age six, was accidentally separated from his biological family. Brierley was adopted out of India by an Australian couple but was reunited with his original family 25 years later after finding his hometown via Google Earth. His story generated significant international media attention, especially in Australia and India.
